info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Transaction Historic-spec
info.description: The Transaction History Management API enables businesses to create and maintain historical transaction records for specific customer accounts. This endpoint allows users to submit detailed transaction data associated with a particular customer and account, ensuring accurate historical tracking. Typical consumers include financial institutions, accounting software, and analytics platforms that require comprehensive transaction records for reporting and decision-making. Leverage this API to enhance your financial data accuracy and customer service capabilities.

post.summary: Retrieve historic transactions for a specific account.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch a list of historic transactions associated with a specific account. By providing account identifiers, users can gain insights into transaction history, which can assist in financial analysis and reporting.

requestBody.description: This endpoint allows the submission of historic transaction data for a specific account. The provided data should accurately reflect the transactions that occurred within the given timeframe. Ensure that all mandatory fields are filled correctly to process the request successfully.
